title: Draft W3-TRIAL (src/minireason/loop/trial.py) and its tests
prompt:
Implement the wave-3 module W3-TRIAL of the automated loop and its tests, so that the test file runs green, and write both files.

WHAT TO PRODUCE: `src/minireason/loop/trial.py` and `tests/loop/test_trial.py`. A run without both files written is not complete. Run `python3 run_tests.py tests.loop.test_trial` after every substantial edit and iterate until it prints OK; then run `python3 run_tests.py` (the whole loop suite) once and report its final line. If a test fails because the module is wrong, fix the module; if it fails because a sibling module behaves differently from what the design says, do not edit the sibling: write the test against the sibling's actual behaviour and record the difference in a comment.

THE DESIGN ENTRY, verbatim from design/design-s7-wave-plan.md:
  purpose: The guard procedure G0-G12 end to end: critic, defender, cross-family judge ensemble, then constitution, schema, uniqueness on both surfaces, operative target, vocabulary, unanimity, order-swap, paraphrase spot-check, no-re-read and no-scoring-key. Blocked outcomes register nothing and are logged by reason code.
  public_interface: run_trial(harness, surface, standard, seats, config, *, mode, reopen_reason=None) -> TrialResult; TrialResult.outcome; TrialResult.blocks; TrialResult.transcript; build_transcript(result) -> str; ReopenRefused
  depends_on: W0-CONTRACTS, W0-STANDARD, W1-SURFACE, W1-GRAPH, W2-PACKS, W2-ROLES
  acceptance: Every block path yields no warrant, one Measure event and a reason code from BLOCK_CODES; an ensemble split blocks and records both rulings verbatim, never a majority; a quote occurring twice in the material blocks; a quote resolving only into the pack framing blocks; a decisive_point absent from case+newline+answer blocks and the emitted transcript satisfies deepreason_core.harness.conforming_transcript; an order-swap flip blocks; a paraphrase flip blocks and is logged against the seat; a paraphrase that does not preserve a quoted span marks the spot-check not_performed rather than passing it; re-reading an unresolved cell without a listed reopen_reason raises ReopenRefused at the write; the whole module runs on OfflineProvider fixtures with zero sockets.
  estimated size: about 680 lines.

READ FIRST, in this order: notes/WAVE2-INTERFACE.md (what waves 0-2 actually expose, which module owns each constant, every code; it supersedes the earlier interface notes where they differ), notes/WAVE1-INTERFACE.md and notes/WAVE0-INTERFACE.md, design/design-s2-roles-and-guard.md, design/design-s3-readings-and-marks.md, design/design-s5-decision-rule.md, design/design-s6-claim-ceiling.md, design/design-s7-wave-plan.md (your entry and its neighbours), then the modules you depend on under src/minireason/loop/ and two existing test files (tests/loop/test_packs.py and tests/loop/test_decide.py) as the house style for tests.

HOUSE RULES. Import every shared constant from its owner module (types, contracts, standard, custody, graph, obligations); never retype a code or a sentence that another module owns. Any new failure code goes in a module-level `NEW_CODES: tuple[str, ...]` with a one-line reason each, and is not added to types.FAILURE_CODES (the integrator folds it). No score, rank, average, majority vote, percentage or progress meter anywhere; a disagreement is `unresolved`; a budget stop is a resource boundary and never "exhaustion". Every acceptance clause in the entry gets at least one test named after it. The module must import under `python3 -W error -c "import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'src'); import minireason.loop.trial"` except for the known repository defect in use_relation_h005.py's docstring (an unescaped backslash-s); if that is what fails, say so and check the import without -W error instead. Zero network: every provider interaction goes through the OfflineProvider fixtures the existing tests use. Do not edit any file under src/ other than the one you are writing, and no file under tests/ other than your test file.

FINAL MESSAGE: the last test lines verbatim, the list of acceptance clauses with the test that holds each, every NEW_CODES member with its reason, and every place you had to deviate from the design entry with the reason.

TOOLING. You have read_file, list_dir, grep, write_file and run_command inside a sandbox. `run_command` accepts only `python3 ...` forms (`python3 <file.py> ...`, `python3 -c ...`, `python3 -m ...`). There is no shell: no pipes, no redirection, no `&&`, no `;`, no `ls`, no `cat`, no `git`. Each command runs alone. Do everything by computation, never by transcription from memory. Never print any string that looks like a credential; report only path and line number for such a hit. Write the deliverables named under WHAT TO PRODUCE; a task without those files written is not complete.
evaluation: Opus integrator runs the tests, reviews against the acceptance clauses, and integrates or rewrites
